verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
